title: 第370章 鬼域里鬼母称王第369章 方寸间三尺戏台
slug: 我在大虞当杀手那些年
content_zh:
“这里哪只鬼说了算？”
朱厌压根不曾正眼瞧过这些灵魂体，质问的声音非是冷漠，而是压根不带任何情绪。
“放肆！”
阁楼门旁一道站立的透明身影飘散而来，厉声怒喝起来，“竟敢惊扰……”
“砰”
其话音未落，脑袋就被一只大手捏住，旋即一头给撞在了一侧梁柱之上，脑袋直接被挤压变形，支支吾吾说不出半点话来。
“本座的耐心不多，本座问什么，你们最好乖乖交代。”
朱厌警告了一句，同时手掌微微发力，那道透明身影被直接捏爆了头。
这一言不合便杀鬼的操作，看得里面的鬼一愣一愣的。
“本座再问最后一遍，这里是哪只鬼说了算？”
声音自阁楼里面传来，所有灵魂体立时回头望去，发现之前还站在门口的朱厌，已是神不知鬼不觉的站在了戏台之上。
此刻已将满屋子鬼镇住的朱厌，裴礼却是无心关注，其思绪仍旧停留在前者将那只灵魂体徒手捏爆的场景。
不知何故，在那一瞬间，裴礼竟是感应到了一道熟悉的气息，这种熟悉感说不上来，却又挥之不去。
好半晌，仍旧没有头绪，裴礼只得暂时将此事搁置。
将注意力投向屋内，便见朱厌已从二楼雅间揪出了一道灵魂体。
裴礼并不知如何分辨灵魂体的境界，但这道灵魂体，比之其他灵魂体要肉眼可见的凝实了许多。
除此之外，这道灵魂体身着锦袍华贵雍容，凛然大气，气势不怒自威，一看便知身份非富即贵。
裴礼扫了眼楼上楼下的众多灵魂体，这才发觉，这些鬼的衣着各异，戎装、胡服、僧袍、道袍，甚至还有不少异域服装。
很显然，这处小世界汇聚的灵魂体，来自天南地北，甚至不同时代。
“这里你最大？”

阁楼里，朱厌单手捏着那道灵魂体，冷声质问。
“前……前辈饶命……”
那道身穿锦袍的灵魂体似是被朱厌的气势吓到，整个鬼躯瑟瑟发抖。
“少他娘的废话！”
朱厌不耐烦道：“这是什么地方，阵眼在何处？”
“阵……阵眼？”
锦袍鬼一脸茫然，似是压根不清楚自己身处何处。
其话音还未落，就见朱厌整个脸色都要黑了下来，赶忙改口道：“前辈息怒，这里是鬼域，在这里鬼母最大。”
“鬼母？”
朱厌开门见山道：“她在哪？”
锦袍鬼道：“鬼母无处不在。”
闻言，朱厌被成功激怒，直接将锦袍鬼的一条胳膊生生扯了下来，后者疼得惨叫连连，而在其肩头断口处，还有星星点点的荧光渗出，又迅速消散，像是血液在蒸发一般。
阁楼门外，裴礼望着这一幕，那股熟悉感再度袭来，只觉得似曾相识。
“这是……”
裴礼努力回想，猛然惊觉，“先天灵炁！”
是的，先天灵炁！
裴礼的第一念头便是，此处莫非就是《太虚引灵篇》中记载的太虚？
可再一细想，又觉得有些对不上。
而现在的问题是，倘若先天灵炁来源于灵魂体，那《太虚引灵篇》算什么？
以吞噬灵魂体而壮大自身灵魂，这岂不是……邪术？
content_en:
"Which ghost has the final say here?"
Zhu Yan had never looked at these soul bodies at all, and his questioning voice was not indifferent, but without any emotion at all.
"Presumptuous!"
A transparent figure standing next to the attic door floated over and shouted angrily, "How dare you disturb..."
"Bang"
Before he finished speaking, his head was pinched by a big hand, and then his head hit a beam. His head was directly squeezed and deformed, and he was unable to speak a word.
"I don't have much patience. You'd better answer your question."
Zhu Yan warned, and at the same time, he exerted a slight force on his palms, and the transparent figure was directly crushed in the head.
This operation of killing ghosts at the slightest disagreement made the ghosts inside look stunned.
"I would like to ask you one last time, which ghost has the final say here?"
The sound came from the attic, and all the souls immediately looked back and found that Zhu Yan, who was still standing at the door before, was already standing on the stage without anyone noticing.
At this moment, Zhu Yan had already filled the room with ghosts, but Pei Li had no intention of paying attention. His thoughts were still stuck on the scene of the former crushing the soul body to pieces with his bare hands.
Somehow, at that moment, Pei Li sensed a familiar aura. This feeling of familiarity was hard to describe, but lingering.
After a long while, he still had no clue, so Pei Li had to put the matter aside for the time being.
Turning his attention to the room, he saw that Zhu Yan had pulled out a soul body from the private room on the second floor.
Pei Li didn't know how to distinguish the realm of the soul body, but this soul body was much more solidified than other soul bodies that could be seen with the naked eye.
In addition, this soul body is dressed in a brocade robe and is luxurious and graceful. It is majestic and has an aura that is not angry but powerful. At a glance, you can tell that it is either rich or noble.
Pei Li glanced at the many souls upstairs and downstairs, and then realized that these ghosts were dressed in different clothes, including military uniforms, Hu clothes, monk robes, Taoist robes, and even many exotic clothes.
Obviously, the souls gathered in this small world come from all over the world, and even from different eras.
"Are you the biggest here?"
In the attic, Zhu Yan held the soul body with one hand and asked coldly.
"Senior...Senior, please spare my life..."
The soul body wearing a brocade robe seemed to be frightened by Zhu Yan's aura, and the whole ghost body was trembling.
"Cut the damn nonsense!"
Zhu Yan said impatiently: "Where is this place? Where is the formation eye?"
"Array... array eye?"
The brocade-robed ghost looked confused, as if he had no idea where he was.
Before he finished speaking, Zhu Yan's face turned dark, and he quickly changed his words: "Senior, please calm down, this is a ghost realm, and the ghost mother is the biggest here."
"Ghost mother?"
Zhu Yan got straight to the point: "Where is she?"
The brocade-robed ghost said: "The ghost mother is everywhere."
Hearing this, Zhu Yan was enraged by the success and directly tore off one of the Jin-robed ghost's arms. The latter screamed in pain, and at the broken part of his shoulder, there were dots of fluorescent light seeping out, which quickly dissipated, as if the blood was evaporating.
Outside the attic door, Pei Li looked at this scene. The familiar feeling came over him again, and he felt like he had seen it before.
"This is..."
Pei Li tried hard to remember, and suddenly realized, "Innate spiritual energy!"
Yes, innate spiritual energy!
Pei Li's first thought was, could this be the Taixu recorded in "Taixu Yingling"?
But when I thought about it more carefully, I felt that something was wrong.
The question now is, if the innate spiritual energy comes from the soul body, then what is "Taixu Yinling Chapter"?
To strengthen one's own soul by devouring the soul body, isn't this... a magic trick?
